title: Large language models in materials science: assessing RAG evaluation frameworks through graphene synthesis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11306-11313
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09726F, Paper

Zen Han Cho, Matthew Osvaldo, Sayan Doloi, Maloy Das, Jun Ci Goh, Bo Sheng Tan, Jiali Wang, Yujia Li, Xingchi Xiao, Amrita Joshi, Leonard Wei Tat Ng
Automated evaluation of RAG systems is increasingly used in scientific applications, yet its reliability remains unclear. Using graphene synthesis as a case study, this work systematically benchmarks three automated evaluators.
